items.title: Show HN: Sourced graph of who partners with whom in Austrian deep tech (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
items.content_text: We decided to make parts of our company database public. This particular views shows partnerships for selected Austrian Deep Tech/Robotics startups / companies. The data is still messy - entity resolution at scale (& cost effective!) is hard. But it already helped analyzed Go-To-Market patterns for these companies and map out trends in a client-project (i. e. "where is the robotics market going?") Our long-term goal is to expand it into a comprehensive company database for the European market (starting with DACH) covering "soft data" such as partnerships, expansion signals (new hires, new sites, patent filings) or management changes. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50044507 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
